camel_example: aliyun resourcecenter SearchMultiAccountResources --region cn-hangzhou --Filter.1.MatchType Equals --Scope 'rd-r40000' --NextToken eyJzZWFyY2hBZnRlcnMiOlsiMTAwMTU2Nzk4MTU1OSJd0000 --SortCriterion.Order ASC --Filter.1.Value.1 'rg-aekzmrjn4ns0000' --MaxResults 10 --SortCriterion.Key CreateTime --Filter.1.Key ResourceGroupId --method POST --force
description_en: Searches for resources in the management account and multiple member accounts of a resource directory
description_zh: 搜索资源目录管理账号和多个成员中的资源
kebab_example: aliyun resourcecenter search-multi-account-resources --scope rd-r40000 --next-token eyJzZWFyY2hBZnRlcnMiOlsiMTAwMTU2Nzk4MTU1OSJd0000 --max-results 10 --filter '[{"MatchType":"Equals","Value":["rg-aekzmrjn4ns0000"],"Key":"ResourceGroupId"}]' --sort-criterion Order=ASC Key=CreateTime --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchMultiAccountResources

parameters.help_en:
The scope of the accounts in which you want to search for resources. Valid values:

- The ID of a resource directory: Searches for resources in the management account and all its member accounts. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159995.html.

- The ID of the Root folder: Searches for resources in all member accounts under the Root folder and its subfolders. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html.

- The ID of a folder: Searches for resources in all member accounts under the folder. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html.

- The ID of a member account: Searches for resources in the member account. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html
parameters.help_zh:
搜索的账号范围。取值： 
- 资源目录ID，表示搜索管理账号和所有成员中的资源。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159995.html。
- Root资源夹ID，表示搜索Root资源夹及子资源夹下的所有成员中的资源。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html。
- 资源夹ID，表示搜索指定资源夹下所有成员中的资源。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html。
- 成员ID，表示搜索指定成员中的资源。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of `NextToken`
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。

当返回结果数据总条数超过`MaxResults`限制，则数据会被截断，您可以使用`NextToken`查询下一页数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

element_fields.help_en: The key of the filter condition. For more information, see the "`Supported filter parameters`" section below
element_fields.help_zh: 过滤条件键。取值见下方`支持的过滤参数`
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The matching method.

Set this parameter to `Equals`, which means an exact match
element_fields.help_zh:
匹配方式。

取值为Equals，表示相等匹配
element_fields.name: match_type

element_fields.help_en: The values of the filter condition
element_fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The sort key.

Set this parameter to `CreateTime`, which means the results are sorted by resource creation time
fields.help_zh:
排序条件。

取值为CreateTime，表示按资源创建时间排序
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- ASC: Ascending order.

- DESC: Descending order.

Default value: ASC
fields.help_zh:
排序顺序。取值：

- ASC（默认值）：升序。
- DESC：降序
fields.name: order
